reviews.title: App breaking bug - Please fix!
reviews.text:
Both me and my wife face an issue where there is a blank screen upon loading with patterns. 

Was my go to Quran app before

reviews.title: You had one job!
reviews.text: The app is no longer opening. I’ve tried updating, offloading, and redownloading but it’s not working. I’m so frustrated. I started using this app just 2 months ago and it has failed me already. I relied on this app for my bookmarks. It’s very frustrating. The app I used previously has never failed in over 10 years of use but it only worked in landscape which was a bit uncomfortable sometimes. The only reason I tried this app is because it works in portrait. You had one job Qamar Apo! And you failed.

reviews.title: Yusuf
reviews.text: Every so often this app crashed and i lose all my bookmarks and can not access the quran, i have to uninstall and reinstall… time to move on and find a better app. Ramadan this year and app is not working for me
